title: 'बिभाजित समय' उपन्यासका पात्रहरूको शैलीबैज्ञानिक आधारमा चरित्र चित्रण {Stylistically based characterization of the characters in the novel 'Bibhagit Samaya}
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेख कृष्णविनोद लम्सालद्वारा लिखित विभाजित समय उपन्यासमा रहेका पात्रहरूको शैलीवैज्ञानिक आधारमा गरिएको चरित्रचित्रणमा केन्द्रित छ । शैलीवैज्ञानिक अध्ययनले कृतिमा निहित घटना तथा पात्रहरूको मानसिकता र व्यवहारको सूक्ष्म अध्ययन गर्दछ । विवेच्य उपन्यासमा रहेका प्रमुख पात्रहरूको शैलीवैज्ञानिक आधारमा विश्लेषण गर्नु यस आलेखको मुख्य उद्देश्य रहेको हुनाले विषयलाई त्यहीँ केन्द्रित गरिएको छ । यस लेखको प्राथमिक सामग्रीका रूपमा उपन्यासलाई लिइएको छ र विषयको सैद्धान्तिक आधार निर्माणका लागि पुस्तकालयबाट द्वितीयक प्रकारका सामग्री लिइएको छ । पात्रहरूको शैलीवैज्ञानिक रूपबाट विश्लेषण गर्दा पात्र वर्गीकरणका सामान्यीकृत सिद्धान्तमा आधारित भएर गरिएको छ । विवेच्य उपन्यासका पात्रहरूलाई पात्र वर्गीकरणका मूलभूत मान्यताका आधारमा शैलीवैज्ञानिक रूपबाट चरित्रचित्रण गर्नु यस अध्ययनको उद्देश्य रहेकाले लेखका रूपमा प्रस्तुतीकरण गर्दा वर्णनात्मक विधि प्रयुक्त छ । पुलिङ्ग र स्त्रीलिङ्ग, प्रमुख, सहायक रगौण, अनुकूल र प्रतिकूल, गतिशील र गतिहीन , वर्गगत र व्यक्तिगत, नेपथ्य र मञ्चीय साथै बद्ध र मुक्त भन्ने आधारमा पात्रहरूको वर्गीकरणस हितको विश्लेषण गरी चरित्रचित्रणलाई तार्किक पुष्टि गरिएको छ । उपन्यासले अघि सारेको केन्द्रीय भाव प्रस्तुत गर्न यहाँका पात्रहरूको भूमिका उपयुक्त छ । यो बहुपात्रीय उपन्यास हो । यहाँ सबभन्दा बढी गौण, त्यसपछि क्रमशः सहायक र प्रमुख पात्र छन् । यस उपन्यासमा मञ्चीय, स्थिर, बद्ध, वर्गीय, अनुकूल र सहायक पात्रको बहुलता छ । यहाँ विश्लेषण गरिएका पात्रहरूमध्ये गौण र मुक्त पात्रको सङ्ख्या कमछ । निष्कर्षतः पात्र प्रयोगका दृष्टिले उपन्यास अब्बल ठहरिएको छ ।
american_english: This article focuses on the characterization of characters in the novel Bibhajit Samaya (Divided Time), written by Krishna Vinod Lamsal, carried out on a stylistic basis. A stylistic study conducts a microscopic examination of the events inherent in a literary work, as well as the mindset and behavior of characters. Because the primary objective of this paper is to analyze the main characters in the novel under discussion on a stylistic basis, the subject matter is focused right there. The novel has been taken as the primary source material of this article, and secondary materials have been drawn from the library to construct the theoretical foundation of the topic. The stylistic analysis of the characters is carried out based on generalized principles of character classification. Since the objective of this study is to characterize the characters of the novel under consideration stylistically on the basis of the fundamental tenets of character classification, a descriptive method is employed in presenting it as an article. Characterization is logically substantiated through an analysis encompassing the classification of characters on the basis of masculine and feminine, major, supporting, and minor, sympathetic and antagonistic, dynamic and static, class-based and individual, offstage and onstage, as well as bound and free. The role of the characters here is well-suited to presenting the central theme put forward by the novel. This is a multi-character novel. Minor characters are the most numerous here, followed respectively by supporting and major characters. In this novel, there is a predominance of onstage, static, bound, class-based, sympathetic, and supporting characters. Among the characters analyzed here, the number of minor and free characters is small. In conclusion, from the standpoint of character utilization, the novel proves to be outstanding.

A stylistic study takes a proper close look at the events wrapped up in the work, plus how the characters think and behave. Seeing as the main goal of this paper is to analyse the key characters in the novel under review using stylistics, the focus is kept right on that. The novel itself is used as the primary material for this paper, and secondary materials were pulled from the library to build up the topic's theoretical base. When analysing the characters stylistically, it's done working off generalized principles of character classification. Because the point of this study is to characterise the novel's characters stylistically based on standard classification rules, a descriptive method is used to lay it all out in the article. The characterisation gets solid logical backing by sorting and analysing the characters across masculine and feminine, major, supporting and minor, sympathetic and antagonistic, dynamic and static, class-based and individual, offstage and onstage, as well as bound and free types. The role of the characters here does a tidy job of bringing out the main theme the novel puts forward. It's a novel with heaps of characters. You get minor characters the most here, followed by supporting and then major characters. In this novel, onstage, static, bound, class-based, sympathetic, and supporting characters dominate the scene. Out of the characters analysed here, there aren't too many minor and free characters. To wrap it up, when it comes to using characters, the novel turns out to be top-notch.
